name: manual_adda4d
claim: Never trust a cherry -v + commit-message match as proof a merge/reanchor preserved content — always diff the local tip against the actual merged headRefOid before declaring it safe

decisions.notes: PR #283 (orama-system, 2026-08-08): a prior cherry-reanchor conflict resolution produced a different final commit than the reviewed branch tip. cherry -v + message cross-check reported everything resolved (message-match proves a same-titled commit exists upstream, not that its content survived), but the actual merged head silently dropped ~660 lines (OSSF-1 pre-commit gate script + wiring, a 439-line reference card, and pilot content in 3 skills). Caught only by diffing the archived branch's real tip against gh pr view's headRefOid, not an assumed one. Fixed by restoring the dropped content on a fresh origin/main branch (PR #291) and codifying a new safe-behind/needs-reanchor gate in git-history-surgery doctrine.
